content:
Amy S: Heads-up: Lark Systems POC kickoff. They want to test mixed variants of anthesis-3b (fp16) + openx-13b (quantized). Need a clear compatibility summary: KV cache behavior, prefix caching, and whether we can route requests between variants without re-staging. Also need delta pricing hosted vs Dedicated. Timeline: demo next Wed. Anyone able to triage?

Raj P: I can drive. Do we have sample prompt mix & expected concurrency? Any latency SLO?

Amy S: Customer is building a chat assistant. Avg seq ~512 tokens, occasionally bursts to ~2k for long-doc retrieval. Concurrency target 40 qps for the demo. SLO: p95 < 250ms for short queries.

Maria L: Short answer: mixed variants are possible but with caveats. Quantized variants (q4_0, q8_0) use different kernel paths and KV cache serialization can differ across backends. Transparent routing only works when variants share architecture + compatible KV format. openx-13b.q4_0 <-> anthesis-3b.fp16 is NOT drop-in compatible.

Tyler N: For Dedicated: we have spare A10G capacity in us-west1 next week. To hit sustained ~40 qps for openx-13b we'll likely need 2 GPUs depending on batching. For demo we can allocate a small burst pool. No infra code changes required for Hosting.

Raj P: Action items: Maria to list which variants can be offered as drop-in compatible, Tyler to confirm Dedicated pricing delta + burst fees, security to review questionnaire. I’ll consolidate into a POC runbook.

Maria L: Perf/quality quick note: q4_0 gives ~1.8x token throughput vs fp16 with ~2–3% quality delta on our evals. q8_0 improves perf further but increases regression risk. Recommendation: q4_0 for the demo to balance quality/perf.

Amy S: Any blocking infra changes for routing/pinning model versions?

Tyler N: No changes for hosted routing. For Dedicated we stage model tar to GPUs and pin versions — staging a fresh model onto GPUs is ~30–45m per model. Recommend staging evening before demo.

security-bot: Lark Systems security questionnaire received: https://redwood-sec/ques/LS-452. Flagged items: KMS integration required, data residency query for EU data, and audit-log retention. @Amy S please share customer sec lead so we can triage.

Amy S: Assigned: David (Lark sec). Looping him in separately. Also we need cost estimate: hosted cost vs reserved Dedicated. Raj?

Raj P: Rough numbers for a demo setup: hosted (openx-13b.q4_0) ~ $85/hr at 40 qps; Dedicated reserved (amortized) ~ $60/hr plus staging/burst fees. I’ll run exact SKU math with Tyler and send exact figures tomorrow.

Maria L: I can run an automated compatibility check: run 1k prompts, compare NLL + semantic similarity to baseline. Will attach perf + small regression CSV. Quick example command to run the test:

```
# run quick compat test (internal tool)
redwood run-compat --model openx-13b.q4_0 --variant anthesis-3b.fp16 --prompts sample_prompts.json --out results.json
```

Also, sample API call to stage a variant for demo:

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/models/variants 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -d '{"base_model":"openx-13b","variant":"q4_0","tags":["demo","poc"],"compatibility_preview":true}'
```

Raj P: Perfect. Maria, can you run that today and share results? Tyler, can you confirm the GPU SKU and burst fee so I can finalize pricing?

Tyler N: On it. Will confirm A10G SKU, hourly amortized, and burst fee in <4h.

Maria L: Starting tests now. I'll post perf numbers + a CSV of any semantic regressions when finished (~3h).

Amy S: Thanks. One more ask: can we enable prefix caching for long-doc workflows? Customer relies heavily on doc-level context.

Maria L: Prefix caching requires same tokenizer and aligned byte-level tokenization. We can enable for variants within the anthesis family. Between anthesis and openx families we don't have safe prefix cache unless we do embedding-level caching as a shim.

Raj P: I'll prepare the POC runbook and timeline: dry run Friday, live demo next Wed.

Amy S: :thumbsup: Adding dry-run to calendar now. @Tyler N please cc infra-ops for the staging window.

Tyler N: Will cc infra-ops and confirm staging slot after I post the SKU/pricing.
